question: Who among the following is related with Chhau dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gopal Prasad Dubey.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chhau dance is a traditional folk dance form that originated in the eastern states of India, particularly in Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Odisha.**
 
• **Gopal Prasad Dubey is a famous Chhau dancer from Seraikela, Jharkhand.**
 
• **He is a Padma Shri awardee and a prominent exponent of the Seraikela style of Chhau dance.**
 
• He has trained several generations of Chhau dancers and has contributed to the recognition and preservation** **of this unique dance form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhau dance is performed during religious festivals and other auspicious occasions, and it is believed to have originated as a form of ritualistic worship of the gods and goddesses.**

 
 
• It is a highly energetic and acrobatic dance form that involves complex footwork, martial arts movements, and elaborate masks and costumes.
